assignments.essential_function: Create a product strategy canvas covering vision, customer problems, positioning, trade-offs, growth, capabilities, metrics and defensibility.

review: The nine-section method makes alternatives and trade-offs explicit, checks coherence, surfaces critical hypotheses and proposes validation. It offers strategic direction rather than a fabricated financial projection.
essential_function: Create a product strategy canvas covering vision, customer problems, positioning, trade-offs, growth, capabilities, metrics and defensibility.

The full primary contains its required guidance and examples; it names no required local supporting file or sibling skill. Do not add unrelated repository content.

External further-reading articles, video courses and optional presentation template remain authored links. The full working method and output structure are in the primary; do not copy external copyrighted content into the package.
